constructor_initialization.interpretation: deterministic initial inventory preparation only; no optimization or selection score

action_model.feasibility: complete native tool preview required; no uncertified proposal is an action
action_model.identity: new decision-model and proposal-model hashes persisted before greedy episode

budget_scope.launcher: source snapshot/copy/import startup reported separately; parent enforces wall timeout from subprocess launch
budget_scope.memory: cooperative process peak RSS; no hard OS reservation or whole-system memory guarantee
budget_scope.panel_cost_limit: Panels reset one existing simulator; initial clone is measured separately. These are not exact generic-learner selection/update costs, and do not resolve postcommit learning cancellation/resume.
budget_scope.timing_covariates: Record background load; normal desktop and OS activity uncontrolled
budget_scope.worker: case load + native preparation + cold adapter/full inventory + initial clone probe + greedy + two frozen-sequence replays + initial RAW policy construction/freeze + two unchanged-policy rollouts + independent audits + receipts

configuration_repair.behavior: Keep native_config_from_case and its truthful direct provenance unchanged; explicitly pin its full configuration. Never force its hash or copy the old provenance string.
configuration_repair.failure: The first attempt compared native configuration identities from two truthful builders with different tissue-support provenance wording. Configuration-only inspection of the actual source arrays found no physical anatomy/tool/access change. The native fingerprint correctly rejected the wording identity mismatch.
configuration_repair.unchanged: Source bundle and cells, affine, labels, support/exclusion masks, tools, access, microsteps, rewards, worlds, action rule, episode counts, and resource caps. No model-score outcome was observed in failed V1.

failure_policy: Fresh output required. Retain all failed attempts, partial inventory receipts and any committed transition after interruption. No partial panel or failed geometry candidate publication, no automatic retry or setting change.
greedy_rule: stable argmax nominal action value across entire certified inventory; STOP first wins zero ties; terminal max3cuts or STOP

question: What are the complete inventory, transition, integrity, selection and independent geometry costs of this distinct native action model before any training budget is chosen?
sequence: preserve exact executable source before worker
load and hash-bind exact source bundle and V2 direct-native configuration; verify all declared physical components match historical configuration
cold construct RAW axis adapter and inspect complete 26-slot inventory
measure one integrity-checked initial clone separately; episode panel resets reuse one simulator
reset to first optimization seed and run one complete nominal greedy episode
freeze complete action IDs before selection
replay same fixed sequence on each of two selection seeds; no new decisions

run the unchanged masked-argmax policy on both selection worlds with no optimizer or gradients
deduplicate independent geometry only within exact source/model/native-history identities; certify all five complete episodes
